purpose: Spoiler-free atmospheric artwork for the investigation catalog. Presentation metadata only; not evidence or a change to immutable case facts.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape case-cover artwork for the Choose your investigation cards in a dark contemporary detective game. Style/medium: cinematic photorealistic environment concept art, believable present-day Britain, detailed weathered materials, restrained film grain. Composition/framing: wide landscape 2:1 image, one readable establishing scene, central focal area safe for responsive cropping. Lighting/mood: tense, quiet and atmospheric, dark olive/charcoal shadows and subtle muted warm highlights, enough midtone detail to read at thumbnail size. Constraints: only the location, no people, no bodies, no blood, no weapons, no evidence closeups, no solution clues, no text, no borders, no logos, no watermarks; this is atmosphere, not an evidence photograph.
Primary request: Grange House. Scene/backdrop: a large inhabited contemporary English country house at night, stone facade and tall dining-room windows with soft warm interior light, a terrace in the foreground after rain, wet stone reflecting the light, dark trees at the edge. Subject: the house and its quiet illuminated windows, a mysterious private estate without any crime being depicted.
assets.alt: Warm-lit windows of a country house above a rain-darkened terrace.
